title: Every-fixed-original-point complete global line injection expected D6 lower for all h>=1

quantifiers.domain: integer h>=1, s=2^h, genuine original W(3,s)
any fixed complete ORIGINAL point-source globally injective physical pair-label assignment
one independently uniformly sampled COMPLETE globally injected original line map, shared over all original Q and all 60 positional cycles

statement: For every h>=1, s=2^h>=2 and EVERY complete globally injected original point map f, with a minimal binom(a,2)>=V=(s+1)(s^2+1), K=binom(a,2), m=K-V and d=s+1, the occupied physical C6 count is at least (a)_6/12-m(a-2)_4>0. True original GQ d-regularity and Hall's theorem give at least max(1,(d)_6) distinct-source-line assignments to six distinct original point factors. Thus T_f>=[(a)_6/12-m(a-2)_4]*max(1,(d)_6), yielding E_g D6(f,g)>=s^6/98304 under ONE uniformly sampled complete globally injected original line map g. At s>=8 the previously registered AA4R bound E_g D6>=s^6/8 is quantitatively stronger; this result contributes h=1,2 coverage and the explicit tensor bridge.
external_dependencies: Minimal physical alphabet missing-edge cycle union bound and exact (a)_6/12 unoriented connected K_a six-cycle count.
True d-regular original GQ bipartite point-line incidence graph, Hall's theorem for d<6 and greedy distinct-line choices for d>=6.
Exact rational s=2,4 boundary and elementary analytic inequalities for s>=8, pinned in source PR484.
limitations: This weaker all-h 1/98304 estimate must not replace AA4R's stronger s>=8 1/8 estimate.
A positive average over g does not imply D6(f,g)>0 for every fixed g, nor all-seven S minimax.
Finite arithmetic checks are not a mechanical proof of the infinite h analytic inequalities.
falsification_boundary: At s=2,4 use matching existence rather than falling(d,6)=0 to incorrectly eliminate every original matching. All assignments must be genuine original incidence flag sets.
